title: Exact and Matheuristic Methods for the Generalized Multiple Strip Packing Problem
summary: We study the Generalized Multiple Strip Packing Problem (GMSPP), in which rectangular items are packed without overlap into open-ended strips of different widths and an item's dimensions may depend on the strip it is assigned to---a recently introduced model bridging cutting and packing and scheduling on heterogeneous platforms. While the single-strip problem possesses a mature exact toolbox, the GMSPP has so far been approached only heuristically.
